# Bundled loader

The release includes the unmodified x86 `dinput8.dll` from
[Ultimate ASI Loader v9.7.4](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/releases/tag/v9.7.4)
by ThirteenAG, under the accompanying MIT license.

- Archive: `Ultimate-ASI-Loader-NoPDB.zip`
- SHA-256: `14b3a1ad018899571ac9aa01482977f3c6d49e6cba99f552d01c5acacd1315e1`
- DLL SHA-256: filled by the build manifest in each package.

The Emergency 4 plugin is original project code. Splinter Cell plugin code and
game resources are not included. The loader is downloaded from its pinned
official release at build time and is not committed as a binary to this repo.
